rules.statement: The senior pupil of Saranankara Thero, even if he was Indasara, had renounced any claim to the Nihiluwa Temple where Sadatissa and his pupils functioned as Viharadhipathis de jure.
rules.supporting_quote: Here too even if Indrasara was the senior pupil of Saranankara, the facts proved show that he had renounced or abandoned any claim he may have had to Nihiluwa where Sadatissa and pupils functioned as Viharadhipathis not merely de facto but de jure.
